extracted.name: Pan-Fried Salmon in Curry Cream Sauce
extracted.description: Salmon cooked in a cream sauce seasoned with mild curry powder, ginger, and lemon juice is a very easy and yummy recipe for 2. Serve with basmati rice and a salad.
ingredient_lines: salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Combine cream, curry powder, lemon juice, and ginger in a skillet and bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to low and slide salmon into the cream. Cover and simmer until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 12 minutes depending on the thickness of the fillets. Flip 1 to 2 times while cooking. Season with salt and pepper.
